name: parspec-pptx
description: Parspec .pptx generation — editable PowerPoint / Google Slides decks built with python-pptx from the design-model.yaml SSoT. House register builds on company deck templates (profiles: master — the Sept-2026 master deck format, default; townhall) with numbered cards, panel rows, problem-to-solution rows, umber funnels, process chevrons and KPI tiles. brand_artifacts register (13.333in, drawn chrome, L1–L12) for standalone board memos. Headless LibreOffice render-and-verify loop; PowerPoint optional.
